articles.title: Big scorelines, one-sided games - are Women's World Cup play-offs working?
articles.summary: The ease in which England saw off Greece in round one of the Women's World Cup qualifying play-offs showed just how inefficient the structure currently is.

articles.title: Why play-off win may not send Wales to World Cup
articles.summary: Wales face Norway in the Women's World Cup play-off final knowing even a famous victory may not be enough to send them to Brazil in 2027.

articles.title: England rocked by injury on eve of World Cup
articles.summary: England have been rocked by injury on the eve of the Rugby League World Cup with Perth Bears-bound Morgan Smithies ruled out of the tournament.

articles.title: England Women's World Cup half-back dilemma
articles.summary: If there is one position that highlights the growth of the women's game in England, it is the competition for the half-back spot at the Rugby League World Cup.
